summary.zh: 设置新增"数据"栏，离线仓库上线：已下载的 zip 可以断网浏览代码了。
summary.en: Settings gains a Data section and offline repositories: downloaded repo zips are now browsable without a network.

items.zh: 新增离线仓库：列表展示已下载的 zip 归档，点击进入全屏代码浏览器（带 IDE 风格文件树），全程离线可用
items.en: New offline repositories: downloaded zips are listed and open in the full-screen code viewer with the IDE-style file tree, fully offline

items.zh: 设置新增"数据"栏，下载加速镜像与清除缓存移入其中
items.en: Settings gains a Data section; the download mirror and clear-cache entries moved there
